scenes.title: Night Sky
scenes.visual: A cute little child looks out of a cozy bedroom window at night. The moon and many stars sparkle outside. Peaceful magical atmosphere.

scenes.title: Star Appears
scenes.visual: One bright friendly smiling star gently flies across the night sky, glowing warmly and leaving a tiny sparkling trail.
scenes.audio: How I wonder what you are...

scenes.title: Above the Clouds
scenes.visual: The camera slowly rises through soft fluffy clouds toward the shining star high above the world.
scenes.audio: Up above the world so high...

scenes.title: Diamond Star
scenes.visual: The main star sparkles brightly like a tiny diamond against a deep blue night sky, with beautiful glowing particles.
scenes.audio: Like a diamond in the sky...

scenes.title: Child Waves
scenes.visual: The child happily waves at the star from the bedroom window. The star twinkles back in a friendly way.

scenes.title: Magical Sky
scenes.visual: Many colorful stars appear around the smiling moon and gently dance in the magical night sky.

scenes.title: Star Dance
scenes.visual: The main smiling star spins gracefully and leaves a glowing sparkling trail across the sky.

scenes.title: Friends Join
scenes.visual: A cute bunny and a cuddly teddy bear join the child and look up happily at the magical starry sky.
scenes.audio: How I wonder what you are...

scenes.title: Moon and Stars
scenes.visual: A friendly smiling moon shines softly while many stars twinkle around it in a peaceful dreamy sky.
scenes.audio: Up above the world so high...

scenes.title: Sparkle Magic
scenes.visual: The main star sends tiny glowing sparkles floating gently down toward the child, bunny and teddy bear.
scenes.audio: Like a diamond in the sky...

scenes.title: Goodnight
scenes.visual: The child, bunny and teddy bear happily wave goodbye to the smiling star while the moon shines softly above.

scenes.title: Ending
scenes.visual: The smiling star gives one large magical sparkle over the peaceful night sky. Elegant glowing text appears: Good Night! ⭐✨
scenes.audio: Final Twinkle melody and gentle chime
